reviews.title: Yep, not just packaging change, formula change too and not for the better…
reviews.body: As others have mentioned, the packaging didn’t simply change like the photos imply. The formula is very different. Replaced with whole milk vs lowfat, and somehow is watery and no longer creamy. The sugar content increased slightly and somehow the product is now super bitter. One of the worst changes is the caffeine content. This went from 120-190 mg which is a substantial increase for people who are sensitive to caffeine and can only have a certain amount. Awful, awful changes. Cancelling subscription immediately :(
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 20, 2026

reviews.title: Incredibly Smooth and Frothy, but Lacks a Strong Coffee Punch
reviews.body: If you love a smooth, cafe-quality iced beverage without having to leave your house or wait in line, the La Colombe Vanilla Draft Latte 12-pack is a fantastic luxury to have in your fridge. It delivers an incredibly unique texture that sets it apart from almost every other canned coffee on the market.The Good: Amazing "Draft" Texture and Premium IngredientsThe standout feature of this drink is the innovative draft can technology. The moment you crack it open, the nitrous oxide infusion creates an incredibly thick, frothy, and velvety micro-foam texture that mimics a fresh latte pulled straight from a tap. It feels incredibly luxurious on the palate.Flavor-wise, it is beautifully balanced. It avoids the trap of being cloyingly sweet or artificial like many grocery store canned coffees. The vanilla flavor is elegant and clean, tasting like a true vanilla bean extract rather than a cheap syrup, and it blends seamlessly with the naturally sweet, cold-pressed milk. It’s perfect for a refreshing, refreshing on-the-go morning treat.Why It’s 4 Stars instead of 5: A Bit Too Weak for Heavy Caffeine LoversThe only reason I am knocking off a star is that the coffee flavor itself gets a little lost in the mix.Because the specialty cold brew beans are blended so smoothly with the frothed milk and vanilla, the actual roast notes are incredibly subtle. If you prefer a bold, robust espresso punch or a strong coffee flavor to kickstart your morning, you might find this draft latte tastes a bit more like premium vanilla milk than a strong coffee beverage.Final VerdictFor anyone looking for a smooth, velvety, and moderately sweet iced latte that feels like a genuine specialty coffeehouse treat, this 12-pack is an excellent purchase. It is portable, wonderfully textured, and delicious—just don't expect a heavy, dark-roast coffee punch!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 19, 2026
